svg.title: Circular unrooted phylogram with four explicit R-M state rings
svg.text: Accepted unrooted196-tip tree; 0/196 genomes independently curated. Provisional snapshot; pending cells remain NA.
Rings, inner to outer: I | II (including IIG) | III | IV
White: screened nondetection. Grey: unknown / incomplete / unresolved. Presence: complete predicted architecture.
Accession-keyed cells; no unresolved result is treated as biological absence. Dashed leaders are not phylogenetic edges.
